summary: The article explains the long-running feud between Dillon Danis and the Paul brothers ahead of his October 14 boxing match with Logan Paul. It traces it to Jake Paul's 2020 Instagram stories using Danis' rumored ex-girlfriend Savannah Montano to call him out, which Montano denied was anything more than a random FaceTime call. It also notes the couple's breakup status is unclear, though comments at the press conference suggest they split.
one_line: Article recounts how Jake Paul used Savannah Montano, Dillon Danis' ex, to taunt Danis in 2020, and why the feud feeds into Danis' fight with Logan Paul.
key_facts: Dillon Danis is scheduled to fight Logan Paul on October 14 in a Misfits boxing contest at the AO Arena, Manchester, which is Danis' first-ever boxing debut.
Danis has gained over a million followers on X while trying to get in Logan Paul's head, including by digging up past relationships of Paul's fiancée, Nina Agdal.
Jake Paul called out Danis on his Instagram story in 2020 by taking a shot at Danis' rumored ex-girlfriend, Savannah Montano.
Savannah Montano is an Instagram model with around 1.6 million followers who was in a relationship with Bellator MMA fighter Dillon Danis.
Jake Paul called out Danis after knocking out ex-NBA star Nate Robinson; Danis was 2-0 at the time and a frequently mentioned potential opponent.
Jake Paul posted a FaceTime screenshot with Montano and wrote, "Aye [Dillon Danis], come get your girl back," followed by "Can't wait to see you soon."
Jake Paul never finalized a fight with Danis and instead fought and knocked out Ben Askren in 2021.
Jake Paul told TMZ, "I hooked up with your girlfriend," but Montano denied it, saying the call came from a random number and she asked "Who is this?" in the video.
Savannah Montano has stopped posting pictures with Danis on Instagram, which were common in 2020, and neither has publicly announced a breakup.
At the first press conference, Logan Paul said Savannah rejected Danis to hook up with real athletes and that his brother hooked up with Danis' ex.
Danis responded at the press conference, "At least I got rid of the sl*t, you're marrying one," suggesting he is no longer with Montano.
There were rumors of Danis pulling out of the Logan Paul fight, but the article says it still seems set to take place.
